text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, the Tenno Sho (Spring) is finally here!
Macqueen's gotta be the only real choice this time...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan
text_block_list.text:
I hope Ikuno Dictus is okay...
Please let her finish the race safely...!

Today, Ikuno Dictus's 3,200m
challenge finally begins.

"It's certain to be the toughest race yet.
Just managing to run through to the end would be
quite an achievement in itself. Howeverâ"

Ikuno Dictus is ready to compete.
She isn't fazed by disadvantages in aptitude
and intends to give it her all. Which is why I—
I pray for her safety, believe in her, and see her off.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (The sheer presence emanating from McQueen... makes the paddock feel completely cut off from the world—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—I am fully aware
that I am a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the end, while they say this Tenno Sho (Spring),
3200 meters at Yodo, is my home turf――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have absolutely no intention of being arrogant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Let us defeat them. Without letting our guard down in the slightest,
and acknowledging everyone equally as strong rivals."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And that is precisely why... I want to run.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This Tenno Sho (Spring),
where an Umamusume like you is running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you from the closest possible vantage point.
The running of Mejiro McQueen...!
